set.prevailing_wage_basis: No program-specific rule found. City land conveyed or leased below fair market value is public funds under Labor Code 1720(b)(3) (transfer of an asset of value for less than fair market price, https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720), but coverage depends on 1720(c) exemptions and project facts, for example 1720(c)(1) private residential projects remain covered when built under an agreement with a local public housing authority such as HACSJ. The Surplus Land Act affordability section, Government Code 54233.5, sets 15 percent lower income units at 10+ units and contains no prevailing wage term. Federal HOME or CDBG layered on a given site (for example Lodi Commons) carries its own Davis-Bacon trigger (HOME 12+ assisted units, CDBG 8+ units), which belongs to those funding records, not this land program.
set.audit_note: Tier 3: prevailing wage left unclear; the only basis is Labor Code 1720(b)(3) below-market land transfer, and the outcome depends on 1720(c) exemptions and deal terms set in each disposition agreement.

reason: The 2026-27 Annual Action Plan, Gov Code 54233.5 and Labor Code 1720 state no prevailing wage rule for City land contributions, so the outcome turns on 1720(c) and project facts.
